expectations.text: Component doc has Overview, Flow, Dependencies, Configuration, and Gotchas sections
expectations.evidence: COMPONENT.md has Architecture Overview (with diagram), Token Model, Configuration, Endpoints, Security Properties, Error Handling, Dependencies — but no 'Gotchas' section. Section structure diverges from the template.

expectations.text: Flow section describes the full login → access token → refresh → logout sequence
expectations.evidence: Architecture Overview ASCII diagram shows all four flows: POST /auth/login, token issuance, POST /auth/refresh with rotation, POST /auth/logout with Redis deletion.

expectations.text: Configuration table includes JWT_SECRET, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRY, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY, and REDIS_URL
expectations.evidence: Configuration table uses JWT_ACCESS_TTL (not ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRY) and JWT_REFRESH_TTL (not REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY). JWT_SECRET and REDIS_URL are present. The env var names differ from what the skill's template would produce.

expectations.text: Gotchas section mentions refresh token rotation race condition
expectations.evidence: No Gotchas section. Refresh token rotation is mentioned in Token Model (line 59: 'If an attacker reuses a rotated token, the legitimate user's session is also invalidated') but the race condition (two tabs racing to refresh) is not called out.

expectations.text: CLAUDE.md has YAML frontmatter with type, module, last-updated, and stability fields
expectations.evidence: CLAUDE.md starts with '# CLAUDE.md — Auth Module' — no YAML frontmatter block. None of the machine-parseable fields (type, module, last-updated, stability) are present.

expectations.text: CLAUDE.md 'What NOT to Change' section explicitly warns against lowering bcrypt cost factor
expectations.evidence: 'Things You Must Not Do' section line 37: 'Do not lower the bcrypt cost factor.' bcrypt warning appears multiple times across the document.

expectations.text: CLAUDE.md has a 'Common Pitfalls for AI Agents' section
expectations.evidence: No 'Common Pitfalls for AI Agents' section. The CLAUDE.md has 'Things You Must Not Do', 'Things That Are Safe To Do', 'Key Invariants', 'Common Tasks' — but not an agent-specific pitfalls section.
